neighbours.label: an anaphoric demonstrative ('that' / 'this') heading a noun that sums up the plan just described ('..., and that effort begins')
fire: The school needs to raise ten thousand dollars, and that campaign starts next Monday.
We plan to repaint the whole church, and that work begins in early May.
The town wants to plant a thousand trees, and this effort kicks off on Saturday.
They hope to rebuild the bridge by winter, and that project is already behind schedule.
Restoring the old theatre will cost millions, and that fundraising drive opens tomorrow.
The club has to recruit twenty new coaches, and that search begins this week.
The museum is moving its entire collection, and that process will take two years.
Cleaning the river will need hundreds of volunteers, and that effort starts this Friday.
